release_notes:
Flash Popup, mobile bulk-reply, DHRU serial input, and admin fixes

New: Flash Popup — a before/after-login announcement popup (replaces the old Login News Popup), with a standard on/off switch.

Fixes:
- Mobile-responsive bulk reply orders — the IMEI order table becomes touch-friendly cards on phones; wider Service column on desktop.
- DHRU services now sync and show the correct primary Serial/SN input instead of an IMEI box.
- Dhru-migrate builds phone numbers as E.164 so migrated numbers keep their country code (fixes failed SMS).
- Bulk admin service grids no longer drop toggles (max_input_vars raised to 20000).
- Disabled categories stay visible in admin (shown as Disabled) so they can be re-enabled.
- Price-change popup no longer counts hidden or disabled services.
- Long or emoji service names no longer abort price-change notices (PackTitle widened to utf8mb4).

Includes migrations for the flash-popup table, the DHRU CustomInput column, and the PackTitle widening.
